scope: Only include sources substantively about sand harvesting, sand mining or riverbed/lakeshore sand extraction in Kenya, or its governance, enforcement, conflicts, livelihoods, transport and environmental effects. Exclude sand dams and water-harvesting projects unless the source concerns extraction; titanium or other mineral-sand mining; quarry stone with no river or riparian link; and news substantially about gold mining.
basinRule: Assign each record to the Kenya Water Resources Authority basin area of its named river, or of its county where no river is named: ke-athi (Athi–Galana–Sabaki: Makueni, Machakos, Kajiado, Kiambu, Nairobi, Taita-Taveta, Kilifi, Kwale, Mombasa), ke-tana (Kitui, Embu, Tharaka-Nithi, Meru, Murang'a, Kirinyaga, Nyeri, Garissa, Tana River, Lamu), ke-lake-victoria (western Kenya counties draining to Lake Victoria), ke-rift-valley (Kerio, Turkwel, Baringo, Nakuru, Narok and other Rift Valley basins), ke-ewaso-ngiro-north (Laikipia, Samburu, Isiolo, Marsabit, Wajir, Mandera); ke-national only for Kenya-wide material. For counties spanning basins, choose by the named river and state the assumption in limitations.
languageNote: Translate a Swahili headline into clear English, preserving the exact source headline in originalTitle.
unitsNote: lorries, tonnes, cubic metres, KSh with time basis
